central_thesis_conclusion: Universal DCA dominance is impossible for an economically distinct causal fully funded rule. The sharp epsilon-DCA unit guardrail preserves a chosen relative-wealth floor and creates a funded discretionary interval, while the terminal-inventory boundary shows that realized adaptive performance is fixed by terminal cash and units. The reviewed empirical layers find no universal, optimal, or confirmed incremental superiority for the corrected-mean signal.

complete_system.conclusion: The complete system is path-sensitive in deterministic and controlled stochastic evidence and negative in every registered historical primary cell.

corrected_mean_signal.conclusion: The corrected-mean selector has parameter- and path-sensitive finite effects, but no multiplicity-adjusted H2 evidence of incremental historical value in the sealed run.

frictionless_relative_wealth_floor.interpretation: finite aggregate audit of the proved epsilon-DCA floor; not a new proof

historical_inference.dependence_boundary: overlapping monthly windows; no independent-sample interpretation
historical_inference.method: registered circular moving-block bootstrap with one 36-test H1/H2 Holm family

interpretation_boundaries: Do not pool cells or sample counts across evidence layers, families, assets, horizons, or schedules.
Deterministic signs are finite stress outcomes, not frequencies.
Stochastic rows are controlled sensitivity over saved seeds, not calibrated market probabilities.
Historical windows overlap; only the 36 registered H1/H2 cells use dependence-aware inference.
Robustness and exploratory rows do not enter the sealed H1/H2 multiplicity family.
Net-of-cost rows are empirical results outside the current epsilon-DCA theorem.
Terminal cash and unit components are ledger-conditioned identities, not causal explanations.
No result establishes parameter optimality, expected performance, or universal superiority or inferiority.

lambda_one.interpretation: aggregate receipt for the source-validated transaction-level DCA collapse

safety_architecture.conclusion: The guardrail supplies the model-free floor; the neutral architecture's realized relative performance is descriptive and was negative in all primary historical cells.
